test_instructions: Open Settings -> Shortcut Guide and ensure the module is enabled.
With the hold setting enabled, hold the Windows key long enough to trigger Shortcut Guide, then release Win and verify the hold-triggered overlay closes.
Press Win+Shift+/ and verify regular Shortcut Guide activation opens independently of the hold setting and remains visible after Win is released.
Disable the hold setting and verify Win+Shift+/ still opens Shortcut Guide while holding Win alone does not.
